title: Prepaid Interest Shortfall: Closing and Funding Borrower Payment Terms
content:
## What a per diem shortfall is

A per diem shortfall is the prepaid interest a borrower still owes on a funded Closing and Funding closing whose charge collected at closing was priced below the per diem the note supports, and the borrower pays it on their own instruction.

## Prerequisite

The per diem shortfall is fixed only after the closing's prepaid interest ledger carries the late-funding refund owed for the unfunded days that fall in the month the loan funded.

In other words, the shortfall waits on the state of the ledger: while the closing's prepaid interest ledger does not yet carry that late-funding refund, the per diem shortfall is not yet fixed.

## How the payment is recorded

A per diem shortfall payment carries no payment channel charge, Larkspur bearing the processing cost of a shortfall its own closing record created.


The payment is recorded as a prepaid interest charge for the period of the charge collected at closing, priced at the shortfall per diem, with what the borrower pays as its amount.

## Payment tool and how it is invoked

The payment is made with the borrower-owned tool `pay_prepaid_interest_shortfall_7376ee5f`. The agent unlocks it and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it on their own funded closing. One run adds one prepaid interest charge entry to the closing's prepaid interest ledger for the amount the borrower pays, dated today, and raises the closing's prepaid interest balance by the amount paid in the same step. The borrower sees the new charge entry and the higher prepaid interest balance.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `closing_id` | reference number of the borrower's closing and funding engagement, as the agent reads it from the closing lookup and passes it on | identifier |
| `interest_from_date` | opening day of the prepaid interest charge period being trued up | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `interest_through_date` | closing day of the prepaid interest charge period being trued up | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `daily_interest_amount` | per diem amount the true-up is priced at | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `interest_amount` | amount the borrower pays | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive figure rounded half up to the cent |

The tool records the number of days in the period itself, counting both ends.

**Return.** A confirmation naming the new charge entry reference number, the closing reference number, the period with its day count, the per diem amount, the amount paid and the closing's resulting prepaid interest balance; the presence of the new entry reference number indicates the payment was recorded.

Hypothetical: for a charge collected at closing that covered the 26th through the 30th, the payment entry's period runs from the 26th through the 30th.
